sources.entry: WooCommerce - WordPress based e-commerce solution. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: WooCommerce monorepo containing the core WooCommerce WordPress e-commerce plugin, its extensions, shared packages, and development tools.
summary.what_it_does: This repository is the development monorepo for WooCommerce, the WordPress-based e-commerce plugin, and related projects. It is organized into three areas: plugins (including WooCommerce Core), packages (PHP and JavaScript libraries for the community, with internal ones prefixed "internal-"), and tools (utilities for the monorepo, some external). Each project has its own package.json and usually a README with project-specific setup. The README mainly covers prerequisites (Node.js, PNPM, PHP 7.4+, Composer), a pnpm install and build workflow, and contribution and support pointers. It explicitly says the repository is not a support channel; users are directed to documentation, forums, and paid support portals instead.
use_cases: Contributing code to the WooCommerce core plugin
Building WooCommerce and its extensions from source
Using WooCommerce shared PHP or JavaScript packages
how_to_run: Install prerequisites: Node.js, PNPM, PHP 7.4+, and Composer (use WSL on Windows)
notable: Monorepo covering WooCommerce core, extensions, shared packages, and tools in one place
Node version is pinned in pnpm-workspace.yaml and auto-used by PNPM scripts
Security issues are reported through HackerOne rather than public issues
Issue tracker is for core WooCommerce bugs only, not support requests
caveats: Not a support channel; issues asking for help are closed
Requires a POSIX environment, so Windows users need WSL
Requires PHP 7.4+ plus Node, PNPM, and Composer before building
